agents
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Command                      Purpose                                                                       
agents                       List bundled orchestration agents and show the current install target.        
agents help                  Render the direct command reference for the agent-only tool.                  
agents list                  List available orchestration agents.                                          
agents install router ai     Install one or more orchestration agents by name.                             
agents install --all --auto  Install all agents to every detected native agent directory.                  
agents remove router         Remove one or more installed orchestration agents.                            
agents where --agent codex   Print the resolved native agent install path.                                 
agents version               Show the current `agents` version and check whether NuGet has a newer release.

╭ notes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│- `agents` is the dedicated agent-only CLI. It does not install skills.                                            │
│- Use `dotnet skills ...` when you want catalog skills or bundle installs.                                         │
│- `agents list` and bare `agents` both show the bundled agent catalog.                                             │
│- `agents version` and `agents --version` both show the current tool version.                                      │
│- Set `AGENTS_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to suppress automatic tool update notices on startup.                           │
│- Agent auto-detect uses only native agent roots. If none exist yet, specify `--agent` or `--target`.              │
│- Explicit `--target` still requires `--agent`, because the generated file format depends on the selected platform.│
╰─
